name: humen-dev
description: Full-stack Claude Code plugins: backend (Django), frontend and spec-driven development.

plugins.name: django-expert
plugins.description: Comprehensive Django backend development guidelines and best practices: models, ORM, views, DRF, testing, performance, security, and deployment.

plugins.name: django-celery-expert
plugins.description: Django and Celery best practices for asynchronous task processing: task design, worker configuration, retries and error handling, Celery Beat, monitoring, and production deployment.

plugins.name: cdrf-expert
plugins.description: Expert guidance for Django REST Framework class-based views using Classy DRF (cdrf.co). Helps choose the right DRF generic/viewset class and override methods safely.

plugins.name: django-safe-migration
plugins.description: Write, review, and rewrite Django migrations for PostgreSQL with zero-downtime guarantees: two-file splits, AddIndexConcurrently, FK NOT VALID + VALIDATE, db_default, and RunPython safety.

plugins.name: django-reviewer
plugins.description: Read-only Django/Python code review subagent (Opus) that preloads the django-expert skill and reports findings on clarity, conventions, ORM/DRF anti-patterns, N+1 queries, and authorization/validation gaps. Never edits files.
